title: Metadata
description: metadata.json contract between allaganeye CLI and the L2a Tauri GUI (#463). Machine-readable source of truth (#612). The human-readable counterpart lives in docs/metadata-spec.md; refine-style semantic constraints (e.g. end_time >= start_time) are enforced by zod (GUI) and InputFileError checks (CLI), not by this schema.

schema_version.description: Payload schema revision (#515). New writes always emit "1"; missing field is interpreted as v1 for backward compat with pre-#515 outputs.

source.description: Absolute path of the source video file as written by the OS that produced metadata.json.

source_duration.description: Total length of the source video in seconds.

source_fps.description: Source recording frame rate (#465). Optional for backward compat with pre-0.2.0 metadata.json that omitted the field; readers default to DEFAULT_FPS (60) when absent.

detected_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when detection ran.

detection_started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC wall-clock timestamp captured at the start of the detect pipeline (#586). Equal to `detected_at` for backward compat. New writers always emit it; pre-#586 metadata.json may omit the field (readers fall back to `detected_at`).

detection_completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC wall-clock timestamp captured immediately before metadata.json is written (#586). GUI CompleteScreen displays elapsed = completed - started in the「所要」column. Pre-#586 metadata.json may omit the field.

gaps.description: Inter-match idle gaps >= 5 minutes (zero or more).

warnings.description: Structured warnings emitted during detection (#518). New writers always emit an array (possibly empty); missing field is accepted for legacy compatibility.

DetectionParams.title: DetectionParams
DetectionParams.description: Parameters used by the detector when this metadata.json was produced.

blackout_threshold.description: Brightness threshold (0-255) below which a frame is considered blackout.

no_audio.description: True when the audio promotion stage was skipped.

use_gpu.description: GPU mode setting. number/boolean for explicit selection, null for auto.

workers.description: Parallel worker count. number for explicit, null for auto.

vtuber.description: True when the --vtuber flag was supplied (#821; the VTuber path never auto-triggers, so request equals resolved). Optional: absent in pre-#821 outputs and means false.

masked.description: True when the --masked flag was supplied (request, #821). The masked fallback can also auto-trigger on zero-blackout recordings; see masked_fallback_used for the resolved path. Optional: absent in pre-#821 outputs and means false.

masked_fallback_used.description: True when the mask-free-region fallback actually produced this result (explicit --masked or zero-blackout auto-trigger, #821). Optional: absent in pre-#821 outputs and means false.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Single match segment. JSON Schema is the strict writer contract; reader-side passthrough for GUI-only edit fields (name / type_override / edited) is provided by zod (.passthrough() on MatchSchema) and only round-trips inside metadata.draft.json, never metadata.json proper.

index.description: 1-based ordinal of the match within the source video.

end_time.description: Match end in seconds (>= start_time; constraint enforced at runtime by zod / InputFileError, not by this schema).

output_file.description: MP4 filename relative to the metadata.json directory.

post_match.description: True when this segment is a post-match trailing run (#805 段階2). Non-destructive flag: excluded from default split output but retained in metadata. Absent / false = normal match.

end_time.description: Gap end (>= start_time; constraint enforced at runtime, not by this schema).

MetadataWarning.title: MetadataWarning
MetadataWarning.description: Structured warning entry (#518). Future codes should be appended to allaganeye/detection/warnings.py::WARNING_CODES; readers must accept unknown codes (forward compat).

message_en.description: English message; readers fall back to WARNING_CODES lookup when omitted.

SystemInfo.title: SystemInfo
SystemInfo.description: GPU vendor probe snapshot recorded by detect/split (#591, extended #761). GUI export uses this to pick the H.264 encoder (NVENC / QSV / AMF / libx264) and query the NVENC parallel slot count SKU table. Optional at the root because pre-#591 metadata.json files don't carry it.

gpu_vendors_available.description: Vendors detected via probe_gpu_vendors() — subset of {"nvidia","amd","intel"}. Empty array means CPU-only host.

gpu_vendor_used.description: Vendor actually consumed by GPU decode in this run. null when CPU was forced (--no-gpu), the cache hit skipped detection, or the run came from split --from-metadata.

gpu.description: GPU model name strings from get_gpu_info_lines() (#761). Used by GUI export to query probe_nvenc_engine_count() for NVENC parallel slot count. Empty array on CPU-only hosts or when probing fails. Optional for backward compat with pre-#761 metadata.json.

BrightnessSamples.title: BrightnessSamples
BrightnessSamples.description: Pre-rendered Pass 1 brightness timeline (#569). The CLI writer caps `values` to ~512 entries via downsampling so the GUI complete screen can draw the SVG without recomputing. Optional at the root: pre-#569 metadata.json and detect cache hits skip the field; CompleteScreen falls back to a sample curve when missing.

interval_s.description: Seconds represented by each `values[i]` (e.g. 25.0 means values[i] is the brightness at i * 25 seconds).

values.description: Average brightness (0-255) per sample, chronological. Length capped at 512 by the writer.

CaptureRegion.title: CaptureRegion
CaptureRegion.description: Game capture rectangle in normalized [0,1] frame coordinates (#810). Serialized form of allaganeye/video/capture_region.py::CaptureRegion (to_dict / from_dict).

source.description: Detector that produced the region. Documented values: "fallback" (FULL_FRAME), "band" (scorebar band ROI), "tierA" (game rectangle), "tierB" (future per-segment precise). Free string: readers must accept unknown values (forward compat, same philosophy as warning codes).

RegionSegment.title: RegionSegment
RegionSegment.description: Per-segment precise region entry (Tier B; consumed by #480/#481). time_range is [t0, t1] in seconds.

CaptureRegions.title: CaptureRegions
CaptureRegions.description: Capture-region timeline resolved by detection (#810; serialized RegionTimeline). `coarse` is the region actually used for Pass 1 brightness measurement: FULL_FRAME on standard OBS runs, the scorebar band ROI (source="band", NOT the full game rectangle) on --vtuber runs, and the mask-free game rectangle (source="tierA") when the masked fallback produced the result. `segments` is always [] until Tier B per-segment detection lands (#480). `fallback_reason` records band-anchor degradation on --vtuber runs (documented values: "anchor_error" = Stage 0 exception, "consensus_miss" = no band consensus); null = no degradation. Optional at the root: pre-#810 metadata.json doesn't carry it; cache hits from pre-#810 vtuber/masked caches omit it (region unknown).

fallback_reason.description: Band-anchor degradation provenance. Free string (readers accept unknown values); null = no degradation.
